title: One way Minecart
description: Ever wanted minecarts to only work in 1 direction? This mods makes minecarts disappear right after getting out!
body:
### How to use this plugin:
1. Download the Plugin
2. Upload it into the `Plugins` folder on your minecraft server!
3. Start the server and have fun!

### What does the plugin do:
* Removes minecarts right after a player gets out!
* Delays the removing of the minecart by 1 tick, as otherwise the player will clip into the floor

### Example usages
* Great for map makers who want a roller coaster which ends somewhere, and cant be abused in any way.
* Puzzle maps, prevents clipping through blocks after getting into the minecart once!
